items.title: Maxon Cinema 4D Adds MCP Support for Claude and ChatGPT
items.rationale: A shipped release. A built-in MCP server lets motion and VFX artists direct Claude, ChatGPT or Codex inside Cinema 4D in plain language, which changes how they work starting tomorrow.
items.excerpt: Maxon, maker of software solutions for creators working in visual effects and motion graphics, has added built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for Cinema 4D through the new Cinema 4D MCP server.
